we are working on biodegradation of oil polluted soil by surfactant and its leaching in the soil.

we have shown that the surfactant can be degraded in situ and can be used as the source of energy for the microbial degradation of oil in soil.
the biodegradation of surfactants in soil is not a simple process, but it is affected by the type of surfactant, soil type and the presence of organic matter in soil.
